title: AI Glitch Art Generator
summary: Make glitch art with AI: pixel sorting, RGB split, datamosh, JPEG corruption and VHS glitch effects. Describe it, pick a glitch style, and Flick makes it.
body_markdown:
### How do I make glitch art with AI?


Describe the subject, then name each glitch and where it hits, such as a portrait with pixel-sorted hair, an RGB split on the outline and a band of compression blocks, then pick a glitch style and generate. In Flick you can then animate the image into a clip.


### Can AI add a glitch effect to a photo?


Yes. Add the photo as a reference image and ask for the glitch you want on it, such as an RGB channel split and horizontal slice glitches, while keeping the same subject, pose and framing.


### What is pixel sorting?


Pixel sorting is a glitch technique that reorders the pixels in rows or columns by brightness or colour, so parts of an image stretch into long, smooth streaks; naming the direction and the area keeps it controlled.


### Can I make a glitch video?


Yes. Generate the glitch image first, then use it as the start frame of an image to video model in Flick and describe one simple motion, such as glitch bands rolling across a screen, while asking to keep the glitch texture.


### Is the glitch art generator free?


Yes, it is free to start with no credit card, and GPT Image 2.6 runs on the free plan. Video models such as Seedance 2.5 need the Standard plan ($20 a month).
